description: Pineapple Buns, or Bo Lo Bao, are a beloved Hong Kong bakery classic, featuring a unique crispy, crumbly topping that resembles a pineapple skin. Beneath this sweet crust lies a soft, fluffy milk bread, creating an irresistible contrast of textures. Enjoy these freshly baked buns warm for a delightful breakfast or afternoon tea treat.

instructions.title: Prepare the Dough
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine 250g all-purpose flour, 30g granulated sugar, instant dry yeast, and salt. Add warm milk and the whole egg. Knead the mixture until a rough dough forms. Incorporate the 25g softened unsalted butter and continue kneading until the dough is smooth and elastic, approximately 10-15 minutes by hand or 7-8 minutes with a stand mixer.

instructions.title: First Proofing
instructions.text: Place the kneaded dough in a lightly oiled bowl, ensuring it is completely covered with plastic wrap. Let the dough rise in a warm, draft-free place for 60-90 minutes, or until it has visibly doubled in size.

instructions.title: Make the Pineapple Topping
instructions.text: While the dough proofs, prepare the topping. In a separate bowl, cream together 60g softened unsalted butter and powdered sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy. Beat in the egg yolk and vanilla extract until well combined. Gradually add 120g all-purpose flour, milk powder (if using), and baking powder, mixing until a soft, pliable dough forms. Wrap the topping dough in plastic wrap and chill it in the refrigerator for 15 minutes.

instructions.title: Shape the Buns and Apply Topping
instructions.text: Gently deflate the proofed bun dough and divide it into 8 equal portions. Roll each portion into a smooth, round ball. Retrieve the chilled topping dough and divide it into 8 equal portions as well. Flatten each topping portion into a thin disc, about 4 inches in diameter. Carefully place a topping disc over each bun, covering about two-thirds of the bun's surface. Use a knife to lightly score a crisscross pattern on the topping, resembling a pineapple.

instructions.title: Second Proofing and Egg Wash
instructions.text: Arrange the shaped buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving ample space between each bun. Loosely cover them with plastic wrap and allow them to rise in a warm place for another 30-45 minutes, or until they look visibly puffed. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Lightly brush the exposed, un-topped dough parts of the buns with the beaten egg.

instructions.title: Bake the Buns
instructions.text: Transfer the baking sheet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the pineapple topping is golden brown and crispy, and the buns are cooked through. Once baked, remove the buns from the oven and transfer them to a wire rack to cool slightly before serving. Pineapple Buns are best enjoyed warm.

tips: To achieve the signature crispy topping, ensure your butter for the topping is softened, not melted, and dont overmix the topping dough to maintain its crumbly texture.
For an extra rich flavor, you can add a thin slice of cold butter inside the bun before applying the topping, a common practice in traditional Hong Kong bakeries.
Pineapple Buns are best enjoyed warm. If making ahead, reheat them in a toaster oven or microwave for a few seconds to restore their softness and crispiness.
